race.comment: LOADED (1) is a well bred entire by I Am Invincible out of a good mare Thrillster who debuts for the Price & Kent Jnr yard. He's jumped out well enough leading in and warrants plenty of respect for the top yard, late bettig key from the wide draw. EMANATING (5) resumes. She contested a few stronger maidens last time in and wasn't disgraced, this looks a nice race for her now with the Stokes yard. THE TROUBLESHOOTER (10) ran a good second here two back before an even effort at Mornington. He can bounce back off a freshen up on speed.  BEE ADMIRED (4) just found one better fresh and has claims despite a tricky map.
